Summary.Title: Governed Expansion Scope Review
Summary.FirstTierDoctrine: IRLT, compounding pharmacy, and DSCSA remain equal first-tier commercialization and demonstration tracks.
Summary.HumanAuthorityRule: Qualified humans and authorized organizational roles retain binding authority.
Summary.SourceOfTruthRule: Official records and executed actions remain in governed source systems.
Summary.Step161Statement: Step 161 is a governed expansion-scope review only. It registers equal first-tier candidate tracks and does not authorize or implement Step 162.
Summary.Step162Gate: EXPLICIT HUMAN AUTHORIZATION REQUIRED AFTER STEP 161 REVIEW

Step162SharedScope.ProposedTitle: First-Tier Triad Shared Assurance Expansion Authorization
Step162SharedScope.Purpose: Authorize one governed local non-production implementation expansion or a shared reusable kernel increment supporting IRLT, compounding pharmacy, and DSCSA without demoting any first-tier track.
PermittedSharedCapabilities: Reusable evidence integrity and rehash workflow
ProhibitedActions: Use PHI or company production data
Step162SharedScope.AuthorizationReason: Explicit accountable human authorization is required after review of Step 161.

GovernanceGates.Requirement: An accountable human must explicitly authorize the exact Step 162 scope.
Platform B v1 remains limited to its six frozen MVP capabilities.
Thread D v1 remains unchanged and continues to display only Platform B v1 state.
New advanced evaluation logic belongs only to Platform B1 / MVP2.
Thread D2 and RAMAT Vision remain DISPLAY / WITNESS ONLY.
Qualified humans and authorized organizational roles retain binding authority.
Official records and execution remain in governed source systems.
Step 162 must use mock identities and synthetic non-production data only.
Missing or conflicted identity, integrity, dependency, authority, timing, or security state must produce or preserve a hold.
The next slice must preserve evidence sealing, rehash verification, tamper detection, and chain-of-custody truth.
The next slice must include tests, audit evidence, reconstruction, integrity manifest, backup or reset path, and explicit recovery behavior.
No production integration, physical manufacturing, dispensing, shipment, clinical administration, or regulated execution is authorized.
